Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, leia o [regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU). Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, UNESP, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ## 🇺🇸 English: 🇺🇸 **English:** Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UNESPRioPretoOpen2025/register) tab. If this is your first time competing, read the [WCA Regulation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by watching this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU). There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, UNESP and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
